answer:
**Opened:** `openInventory()` in `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` (via `this.dialog.open(InventoryComponent, {...})`).

**Data passed:** an `InventoryDialogData` object `{ characterId: this.characterId, sessionId: this.sessionId }`, injected into `InventoryComponent` via `MAT_DIALOG_DATA`.

**Component:** `frontend/src/app/components/inventory/inventory.component.ts` (`InventoryComponent`), which uses `GameApiService` (`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`) to call:
- `getInventory(characterId)` → `GET /api/character/{characterId}` (extracts `inventory` field)
- `equipItem(characterId, itemId, equipped)` → `PATCH /api/character/{characterId}/equip`
- `dropItem(characterId, itemId)` → `DELETE /api/character/{characterId}/inventory/{itemId}` (also used to "use" a potion before healing locally)

Backend logic for inventory lives in `worker/src/services/character.ts` (`getInventory`, `updateCharacter`).
